#  11448 - Semiconductor Materials and Device Physics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11448 - module is no longer offered from SS 2019**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Semiconductor Materials and Device Physics**  |  
|  Physik der Halbleitermaterialien und -bauteile   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Seibold, Götz 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Goal of the lectures is to give students a solid background in semiconductor physics to enable them to understand the principles of important microelectronic devices which set the basis of electronic equipment used by everybody in daily life applications. Besides semiconductor physics and device fabrication, this includes lectures on transistors, memories, photonics, photovoltaics, solid state lighting, sensors etc.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Silicon wafer manufacturing (crystal growth, epitaxy processes etc.)
  * Si cleanroom processing (implantation, etching, lithography etc.) 
  * Transistors (e.g. Field effect transistors, Heterobipolar transistors etc.)
  * Memories (e.g. Flash, DRAM, RRAM etc.)
  * Photonics (e.g.LEDs, lasers, photodetectors, modulators etc.)
  * Sensors (e.g. optical sensors, surface acoustic wave filters etc.)
  * Photovoltaics (e.g. concentrator photovoltaics, thin film photovoltaics etc.)

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of solid state physics and chemistry based on a Bachelor study course in physics.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Consultation / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Research paper/essay / 45 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Physics of Semiconductor Devices, S.M. Sze and Kwok K. NG, Wiley 2007.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  **Prerequisite:**
  * Written homework with final presentation of results

**Final module examination:**
  * Oral examination, 30-45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Physics M. Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Experimental/Applied Physics“. 

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture "Semiconductor Materials and Device Physics"

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 16.01.2019 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
